summary: The World Cup Hub source brief is specific, but the brand profile omits the three concept fields required to keep system synthesis out of generic task-led-product-surface fallbacks. Author a domain-specific application concept, layout skeleton, and design differentiation before any downstream regeneration.
decisions: Restart at the earliest incomplete stage, concept, rather than polishing the existing generated UI.
Preserve the source brief, approved component scope, and Semantic OS color authority; the concept fields must translate this domain evidence into a distinctive application model.
Do not pass the project to token curation or system compilation until all three concept fields are explicit and the profile validation contract covers them.

gate_results.command: jq -e 'has("application_concept") and has("layout_skeleton") and has("design_differentiation")' projects/world-cup-hub/brand_profile.json
gate_results.evidence: All three queried fields are null because they are absent from the current profile.
The existing generated component inventory passes with 19 components, 0 needs-authoring items, and 81 declared tokens; this does not compensate for the earlier concept-stage omission.
Semantic color authority is current and unchanged; the remediation is concept synthesis, not another color migration.

risks: Regenerating downstream artifacts before concept authoring would preserve generic fallback composition and stale semantic-color provenance.
The current profile validator does not require these concept fields, so a green validation result is not yet sufficient concept-stage evidence.
next_action: Brief Author adds application_concept, layout_skeleton, and design_differentiation to the World Cup Hub brand profile, extends concept validation coverage if required, validates the profile, and hands the completed concept back to Team Lead with current artifact hashes.
